{{Top|leg}}
'''Moonstrike''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] resistance movement started, by a mysterious person named [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]], on [[Acherin]] before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over the government.

Flame traveled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to planet contacting any resistance movement. This was really just a part of the secret project, [[Twilight (operation)|Twilight]].
